finding: the Pi marker test is live-tagged and not selected by current live CI filters; released user and normal workflow: no current released user loses behavior because the candidate passes the explicit approved live-tag command; observable harm: only a future Pi builder regression could escape automated CI; affected boundary: future AC-1 and AC-2 regression detection; trigger evidence: hypothetical future edit, while the current focused -tags live proof passes.

class: correct-but-disproportionate; why-not-material: the approved current candidate runs and passes the explicit live-tag Pi marker proof, so no released workflow or value AC is presently broken and moving the live runner across build tags exceeds the harness-only need; promotes-when: a supported Pi journey exhibits foreign-marker contamination or the deterministic Pi check becomes an explicit required release-lane guarantee
